name: Model Market
intro: Bringing Lewisham's Model Market back to life as Kraft Lewisham: the plan, the budget and the people to open it well.

sections.text: Pre-opening and first-year marketing plan, built against the P&L: PR, launch events, outdoor, signage and an on-site marketing role.
Briefing PR agencies, with launch support through the landlord, and keeping the council on side.
